{{Alo inversion}}'''ωα Do not spread hatred'''

== Interpretation ==
This commandment is the most open ended commandment of the [[Omega Covenant]] and as such it is important

It is about avoiding spreading hatred, but also avoiding envy, and avoiding inducing envy

The main job of the [[Omega priesthood]] is to make people live by this commandment
